description: This Java interface defines a generic message listener for JMS (Java Message Service) within the Apache OFBiz framework. It extends the standard MessageListener and adds methods for lifecycle management (load, close, refresh) and connection status checking, with exception handling via GenericServiceException.

classes.name: GenericMessageListener
classes.description: An interface extending the JMS MessageListener with additional lifecycle methods for use within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the listener and all associated connections, throwing a GenericServiceException if an error occurs.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Starts the listener and establishes all necessary connections, with exception handling.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the connection for the listener, with exception handling.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the listener has an active connection, returns true if connected.
